description: This Java source file defines the ProductFeatureServices class, containing multiple static service methods related to product features, variants, and categories within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving product features by type, finding existing product variants, generating variant combinations, and fetching products by category with specific features.

classes.name: ProductFeatureServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for managing product features, variants, and category products in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductFeaturesByType
methods.description: Retrieves product features classified by type, filtered based on provided category, group, or product identifiers.

methods.name: getAllExistingVariants
methods.description: Finds all variant product IDs related to a given product ID that possess specified features.

methods.name: getVariantCombinations
methods.description: Generates possible variant combinations for a product by iterating over its features, and identifies existing variants for each combination.

methods.name: getCategoryVariantProducts
methods.description: Fetches products within a category that match specific product features, including their variants.
